name: Cashew Milk
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as cashews are naturally low FODMAP and the milk form dilutes any potential residual FODMAPs further.
preparationTips: Choose unsweetened varieties to avoid added high FODMAP sweeteners
Check labels for inulin or chicory root which are high FODMAP
Store-bought is often more diluted than homemade versions
Shake well before use as separation is natural
nutritionalHighlights: Lower in protein than dairy milk
Often fortified with calcium and vitamin D
